title: Miklo Tha Kid presents the fantastic new single, "Get Out Your Feelings"
htmlContent:
Miklo Tha Kid is a talented recording artist and songwriter from Albuquerque, New Mexico. The talented lyrical genius has built incredible prominence from his highly infectious sound. The musician presents his recent work, "Get Out Your Feelings," showcasing his distinctive musicality and capability to make his artistry more proficient and unique.

Miklo Tha Kid, on his recent track "Get Out Your Feelings," brings a smooth sound in the production that makes you feel like you've conquered the world and relax and listen to the game he brings. His music mixes electronic melodies with organic instruments over heavy-hitting fast-paced drums accompanied by catchy flows, witty lyrics, and a unique voice.
